I won't put a number on that, because there isn't a safe one to give. Sauna suits and cutting water to make weight is how people end up dizzy, cramping, or in the ER, and it also tanks your strength and performance on the day. If you have a weigh-in coming up, talk to a doctor or a dietitian who works with weight-class athletes before you try any water cut.

The safer play is to plan the weight well ahead of the event. Steady, boring work over weeks beats a panic cut in the last 24 hours every time. If you tell me the sport, the weight class and the date, I can set up your training around it, and the app can work out targets for a gradual loss.
